goal: Improve TP=1 G11 packed-NVFP4 end-to-end latency versus flashinfer.trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe.

experiment.name: SwiGLU/requant padding-only zero fast path
experiment.idea: Avoid full cudaMemset of mid_packed, mid_scale, and mid_scale_swizzled by zeroing only rows where row_in_expert >= expert_counts[expert], then computing valid routed rows exactly as the metadata_valid_slots path.
experiment.conclusion: Rejected. Correctness was stable for the tested run, but the row-wise padding zero kernel cost more than the saved full memsets. End-to-end latency regressed slightly and swiglu_requant regressed by about 16.7us versus the current best profile.
do_not_repeat: Do not replace the full memset path with one-thread-per-padding-row zeroing.
If revisiting this area, zero padding with a more bandwidth-coalesced kernel or remove mid_scale output entirely instead of serial row loops.

recommended_next_focus: A larger gain likely requires reducing BMM work or eliminating the GEMM2-out/final-scatter memory round trip.
Micro-optimizing padding zero for SwiGLU/requant is not enough to close the FlashInfer gap.
